knowledge_abstraction.bug_theme: Empty tensor input bypasses dimension validation
knowledge_abstraction.general_principle: Special-case execution paths for empty or degenerate inputs may bypass normal argument validation, leading to API contract violations when invalid dimensions or ranks are supplied.

risk_dimensions.shape: Zero-element tensor shapes and degenerate dimensions that trigger specialized execution paths.
risk_dimensions.execution_state: Execution paths selected for all-empty input collections may bypass normal dimension validation.

failure_mechanism.description: Operators with legacy or specialized handling for zero-element tensors may omit dimension validation when all inputs are empty, causing out-of-range dimension arguments to silently succeed.

input_exploration: Explore zero-element tensors with different ranks
Vary dimension arguments across invalid positive and negative values
Compare behavior of empty input collections against non-empty collections
constraint_awareness: Dimension arguments must satisfy -rank <= dim < rank
Empty-input special paths may not enforce the same rank and dimension constraints as normal paths
Invalid dimension arguments should raise API contract errors
oracle_strategy: Expect RuntimeError or equivalent validation exception for out-of-range dimension arguments
Flag silent success on empty inputs as a validation bypass
Compare empty-input behavior with non-empty baseline for identical invalid arguments

transferability.reason: The principle applies to APIs that accept tensor collections and dimension/axis arguments with special handling for empty or degenerate inputs, but the exact validation bypass depends on each operator's legacy code paths.

important_considerations: Prioritize operators with tensor-list inputs and dimension/axis arguments
Include empty, zero-size, or otherwise degenerate tensor shapes
Probe invalid dimension values beyond the valid rank range
Check for divergence between normal and special-case validation paths
generation_strategy: Generate harnesses that systematically vary tensor ranks, empty shapes, and dimension arguments while using contract-based oracles to detect missing validation errors; do not hard-code the original API's exact bug conditions.
